title: Data for Full-time Trained and Untrained School Counsellors
what_it_is: Data for Full-time Trained and Untrained School Counsellors

sections.label: School counsellor deployment numbers
sections.summary: All primary, secondary, JC and CI schools have one or two school counsellors, with about 410 deployed currently.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: As I mentioned earlier on, all our Primary school, Secondary school, Junior College (JC) and Centralised Institutes (CI) schools are resource with one or two school counsellors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: And in total, we have about 410 school counsellors deployed in our schools currently.

sections.label: Flexi-adjunct and teacher-counsellors
sections.summary: About 120 flexi-adjunct counsellors are engaged, over 700 teachers trained as teacher-counsellors, aiming for over 1,000.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Overall, about 120 flexi-adjunct school counsellors are engaged in our schools.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: MOE has also provided further training to over 700 teachers, who are then deployed as teacher-counsellors in our schools to work alongside the school counsellors.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Currently, there are about two to three teacher-counsellors in each school and we aim to increase the number of teacher-counsellors to over 1,000 over the next few years.

sections.label: Reduced duties for teacher-counsellors
sections.summary: Schools can reduce teaching or CCA duties for teacher-counsellors to give them more time with students.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: Schools does have the flexibility to reduce teaching or CCA duties for teacher-counsellors to provide them more time to spend with their students if they need to.
